name: Rise | 200mg Tincture | RSO + Gushers
description:
Formulated in refined hemp seed oil, RSO+ tincture is a combination of?RSO?(Rick Simpson Oil) and live resin which contains additional cannabinoids like THCA, CBGA, and strain specific terpenes which are not typically found in RSO. This formulation is an excellent choice for those with low THC tolerance who wish to benefit from the therapeutic potential of RSO and live resin.

Key Benefits

Relieves pain symptoms

Reduces inflammation

Helps to manage stress and anxiety

Promotes healthy sleep

Strain-specific

• 200mg THC from RSO + strain-specific live resin and minor cannabinoids per bottle 

• 6.66mg THC from RSO + strain-specific live resin and minor cannabinoids per serving 

• 30mL per bottle 

• Made with hemp-seed oil 

• 100% cannabis-based 

• Nut free

• Vegan

Squeeze the bulb to draw the tincture into the dropper. Place the tip of the dropper under your tongue, and compress the bulb to administer the tincture sublingually. Wait 5 to 30 minutes before taking additional doses. Continue as needed until the desired therapeutic benefit is achieved.
